# BCGov Crow - v0.11.2

## Release type

Patch release

## Summary

Crow extends its existing technology-routed architecture, development, testing,
and security review skills with Java guidance.

## Highlights

- Java architecture and development modules cover modern JDK choices, HTTP
  applications, safe persistence, builds, CI, and operational readiness.
- Container-specific guidance distinguishes embedded and external Tomcat,
  Jetty, Undertow, and Jakarta EE application servers and their enabled profiles.
- Java unit and integration testing guidance covers JUnit Jupiter, real HTTP
  boundaries, database semantics, and deployed WAR verification.

## Changes

- Skill routers load Java modules only for relevant Java projects and tasks.
- The README inventories .NET-specific modules alongside their Java counterparts.
- Existing skills, agent names, and output contracts remain unchanged.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: Passed - 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: Passed - 206 files; Java modules included.
- Archive inspection: Passed - 206 entries, including all 10 Java modules;
  no evidence or local-state paths.
- Additional checks: Crow release draft tests passed; Sonar quality gate
  passed with 0 new-code issues (generic scanner cannot analyze bundled C#
  examples); two independent model reviews completed and material findings
  incorporated.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.11.2 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.11.2.zip --global --target copilot
```
